summary: iBio, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 14, 2026, furnishing an updated corporate presentation under Items 7.01 and 8.01, with the deck attached as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference. The presentation, titled 'Breakthrough Antibodies for Obesity and Cardiometabolic Diseases,' is intended for investor, analyst and other meetings. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural or regulatory terms are disclosed. This is a routine Regulation FD disclosure and other-events filing; there is no deal to arbitrage, so watch for any substantive strategic or financing announcement that a future presentation update might accompany.
